title: Clinician-supervised evaluation of a local English consultation documentation assistant

guidance_basis.name: DECIDE-AI
guidance_basis.note: This skeleton covers early-stage system description, intended use, workflow, evaluation, safety, and reporting domains. Obtain and map the canonical checklist locally before protocol approval; no compliance claim is made.

study.intended_use: English outpatient consultation documentation assistance under clinician supervision; the system does not independently diagnose, prescribe, or sign a medical record.

system_and_workflow.clinician_role_and_override: Clinician reviews audio, transcript, evidence-linked facts, warnings, and note; clinician may edit or reject every proposal. Only clinician-approved content is treated as approved.

readiness_gates: Obtain the canonical DECIDE-AI checklist locally and complete an item-level crosswalk.
Name an institution and accountable clinical owner.
Recruit appropriately qualified independent reviewers and document qualifications.
Obtain ethics, privacy, and institutional approvals before any recruitment or patient-data collection.
Freeze the system, comparator, outcomes, adjudication rules, and statistical plan before enrollment.
Complete a dry run using synthetic data and verify safety escalation and fallback procedures.
evidence_boundary: Protocol planning only. No participants, clinical observations, adjudicated outcomes, or study results are represented.
